sentences.text: There is no in-force evidence here that sets a minimum credit score for home loans.
The in-force home-loan materials describe the loan purpose and interest terms, but they do not state any credit-score threshold.
The applicable UCB directions shown here address housing-loan conduct and related loan terms, not a minimum credit-score requirement.
I searched the housing-loan and loan-policy materials provided, and none of them contains a minimum credit score for this case.
